## Test And Evaluate

- [API response format](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/test-and-evaluate/strengthen-guardrails/handle-streaming-refusals.md): When streaming classifiers detect content that violates Anthropic's policies, the API returns this response:
- [Define your success criteria](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/test-and-evaluate/develop-tests.md): Here are some criteria that might be important for your use case. This list is non-exhaustive.
- [Specify the desired output format](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/test-and-evaluate/strengthen-guardrails/increase-consistency.md): Precisely define your desired output format using JSON, XML, or custom templates so that Claude follows every output formatting element you require.
- [Jailbreaks and direct prompt injection](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/test-and-evaluate/strengthen-guardrails/mitigate-jailbreaks.md): In this threat model, a user is deliberately crafting inputs to manipulate your application into producing content or taking actions you don't want it to.
- [Basic hallucination minimization strategies](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/test-and-evaluate/strengthen-guardrails/reduce-hallucinations.md): Even the most advanced language models, like Claude, can sometimes generate text that is factually incorrect or inconsistent with the given context.
- [Before you try to reduce prompt leak](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/test-and-evaluate/strengthen-guardrails/reduce-prompt-leak.md): Consider using leak-resistant prompt engineering strategies only when **absolutely necessary**.
